description.value: A large, supervised riverside campground on the banks of the Chehalis River in BC's Fraser Valley, reached by paved road; the main draw is steelhead and salmon fishing, with a forest trail down to the river.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active campground with 135+ sites along the Chehalis River, operated under a partnership with Sts'ailes First Nations; it explicitly welcomes 'bikers' and confirms online reservations are available. No specific amenities like showers, potable water, or hiker/biker-specific pricing are mentioned in the fetched content, so those remain null. Two concerns arise: OSM names it 'Chehalis River Main Campground' while the website consistently uses 'Chehalis River Campground', and OSM lists 16300 Morris Valley Road while the About Us page lists the operator office at 16440 Morris Valley Road.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Chehalis River Main Campground' but the website consistently uses 'Chehalis River Campground' with no 'Main' qualifier.

Address discrepancy: OSM lists the campground at 16300 Morris Valley Road; the About Us page lists the operator (West Harrison Reservations) office at 16440 Morris Valley Road, Agassiz, BC V0M1A1. These may refer to different buildings/parcels, but the campground address could not be independently confirmed from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active campground that explicitly welcomes cyclists, offers online reservations, has on-site supervision, and is well-positioned in the Fraser Valley for touring routes — a useful listing for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Operated by West Harrison Reservations under a partnership agreement with the Sts'ailes First Nation on behalf of Recreation Sites and Trails BC (sitesandtrailsbc.ca). Firewood is available on-site (cash only). A separate Chehalis River Group Site also exists under the same management.

wow_evidence: explicitly welcomes 'bikers'…partnership with Sts'ailes First Nations
